scope: Central construction, local lossless compression experiment; not pooled execution, actual network measurement, adopter benefit, or modest-device evidence
training: Only train split; fixed k=50, d=8, steps=1, threads=0, dict_id=1
selection: Minimize tune split framed payload plus one raw dictionary delivery, tie by smaller dictionary; freeze before test scoring
record_order: SHA256(record bytes) ascending within each split
baselines: Independent Zstd level 3 frames with raw fallback and exact-content caching
Length-prefixed whole-batch Zstd level 3, when batching is allowed
framing: Each record: 1-byte mode, 4-byte original size, 4-byte body size, 32-byte original SHA256, body. Dictionary delivery: same frame containing raw dictionary. Costs are encoded application bytes, not observed wire traffic.
dictionary_policy: Choose min(raw, ordinary compression, dictionary compression) per record; fetch dictionary only if chosen; charge first use, repeat delivery after eviction, and another full delivery in update sensitivity
controls: Missing dictionary falls back to independent frames
Wrong dictionary rejected by SHA256 before decoder use

exploratory_success.decode_p95_allowance: No more than max(5% of baseline, 5 microseconds) added per record; local microbenchmark only

cost_sensitivity: Report central training input bytes and dictionary training wall/CPU separately; show full training-input acquisition charged once. No pooled job/verification cost is presumed zero: pooling is not measured.
limitations: Project docs are a proxy; no observed reuse/update trace
Source-separated split removes exact duplicates but may contain related/near-duplicate documentation
No deployment or generative-lexicon quality claim
Full G4 requires additional network, update, eviction, and independent-consumer evidence
